parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console and go to the Workspace Management page to obtain the ID. You must specify either this parameter or ProjectIdentifier to determine the DataWorks workspace to which the operation is applied
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks管控台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。该参数与ProjectIdentifier参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console and go to the Workspace Settings panel to obtain the name. You must specify either this parameter or ProjectId to determine the DataWorks workspace to which the operation is applied
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间名称。您可以登录DataWorks控制台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间名称。该参数与ProjectId参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workflow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173945.html operation to query the workflow ID
parameters.help_zh: 业务流程的ID，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173945.html接口，根据名称查询对应业务流程的ID
parameters.name: business_id
